steps.text: The user picks a workbook and starts the import.
The app reads the workbook and parses each sheet, recording a warning for every cell it cannot read.
The app reports the outcome, including the rows imported, the rows skipped, and any stage that failed.
The app proposes a column mapping for the sheet being imported.
The user confirms the proposal or corrects it.
The app coerces each cell using the confirmed mapping and records the mapped rows on the run.

classes.name: ImportOrchestrator
classes.generalDescription: Coordinates workbook imports and retains the result of each run.
classes.designRole: Connects workbook reading and column mapping, accumulates mapped rows, and reports the import outcome to the user.

methods.name: run
methods.generalDescription: Executes a workbook import using the selected file and import options.
methods.designRole: Passes parsed sheets to the mapper and stores the completed run in result so the outcome can be displayed again.

methods.name: planStages
methods.generalDescription: Builds the ordered stages of an import run.
methods.designRole: Determines which sheets to open, their read order, and which may be skipped so failures can be attributed to a stage.

methods.name: handleStageFailure
methods.generalDescription: Processes stage failures and prepares the run outcome for display.
methods.designRole: Uses the diagnostic summary to report imported rows, skipped rows, and any failed stage to the Import Panel.

classes.name: WorkbookReader
classes.generalDescription: Reads workbook files and makes their sheets available for parsing.
classes.designRole: Opens the selected workbook, streams sheet rows to the parser, and retains the current decoded sheet alongside run diagnostics.

methods.name: open
methods.generalDescription: Opens a workbook file and reads its contents.
methods.designRole: Reads the selected file from disk according to the stage plan, with a read error ending the run before sheet parsing.

methods.name: readSheet
methods.generalDescription: Decodes a workbook sheet and supplies its rows for parsing.
methods.designRole: Streams raw rows to SheetParser and replaces buffer with the decoded sheet so it can be read again without decoding the workbook.

methods.name: collectDiagnostics
methods.generalDescription: Collects diagnostics produced while reading and parsing a workbook.
methods.designRole: Makes sheet parsing warnings available for the import's final diagnostic summary.

classes.name: SheetMapper
classes.generalDescription: Maps sheet columns to target columns and converts sheet rows into target records.
classes.designRole: Proposes a column mapping for user review, applies the confirmed mapping through TypeCoercer, and adds mapped rows to the run result.

methods.name: constructor
methods.generalDescription: Initializes the sheet mapper and its dependencies.
methods.designRole: Sets up the ColumnMatcher and TypeCoercer used for mapping proposals and cell conversion.

methods.name: mapSheet
methods.generalDescription: Transforms a parsed sheet into records using a column mapping.
methods.designRole: Applies the mapping accepted in Mapping Review, coerces each cell to its target type, and appends mapped rows to the orchestrator's result.

methods.name: proposeColumns
methods.generalDescription: Prepares a proposed mapping from sheet headers to target columns.
methods.designRole: Asks ColumnMatcher to rank candidate columns and presents the suggested mapping and confidence scores in Mapping Review.

classes.name: SheetParser
classes.generalDescription: Parses sheet headers and rows into structured data.
classes.designRole: Processes decoded sheet rows and reports each unreadable cell to ParseDiagnostics so skipped data can be explained in the final report.

methods.name: parseRows
methods.generalDescription: Parses raw sheet rows into values for downstream processing.
methods.designRole: Processes rows in sheet order and records warnings with the location and raw text of every unreadable cell.

methods.name: parseHeader
methods.generalDescription: Parses a sheet's header row into column names.
methods.designRole: Provides the header names used to propose mappings between source columns and target columns.

classes.name: ParseDiagnostics
classes.generalDescription: Stores parsing warnings and summarizes them for reporting.
classes.designRole: Accumulates unreadable-cell warnings across all sheets and supplies a per-stage summary for the final import outcome.

methods.name: record
methods.generalDescription: Records an individual parsing warning with its source context.
methods.designRole: Retains each unreadable cell's sheet, row, column, and raw text so the report can explain skipped data.

methods.name: summarize
methods.generalDescription: Condenses collected diagnostics into a reportable summary.
methods.designRole: Groups warnings by stage and severity, with representative examples, for ImportOrchestrator to include in the run outcome.

classes.name: ColumnMatcher
classes.generalDescription: Matches source header names to candidate target columns.
classes.designRole: Ranks possible column mappings using normalized header names so the user receives a consistent proposal to review.

methods.name: match
methods.generalDescription: Finds and ranks target columns for source headers.
methods.designRole: Produces the candidate matches used by SheetMapper to propose a column mapping.

methods.name: scoreCandidate
methods.generalDescription: Scores how well a source header matches a candidate target column.
methods.designRole: Uses normalized header text to keep candidate rankings stable across differences in casing, spacing, and punctuation.

methods.name: normalizeHeader
methods.generalDescription: Converts header text into a consistent form for comparison.
methods.designRole: Lowercases and trims header names and removes punctuation before candidate scoring.

classes.name: TypeCoercer
classes.generalDescription: Converts cell values to the types required by target columns.
classes.designRole: Supplies the existing conversion behavior reused by SheetMapper after the user confirms the column mapping.

methods.name: coerceCell
methods.generalDescription: Converts one raw cell value to a requested target type.
methods.designRole: Applies the type assigned by the confirmed column mapping to produce values for the mapped rows.

components.name: Import Panel
components.generalDescription: Provides the user interface for starting workbook imports and viewing their outcomes.
components.designRole: Sends the selected workbook and import options to the orchestrator and displays imported rows, skipped rows, and any failed stage.

components.name: Mapping Review
components.generalDescription: Lets users review and adjust mappings between source and target columns.
components.designRole: Displays proposed mappings with confidence scores and returns the user's confirmed mapping before cells are coerced.

components.name: Workbook File on Disk
components.generalDescription: The workbook file that supplies the source data for an import.
components.designRole: Provides raw workbook bytes to WorkbookReader, or a read error if the selected file cannot be opened.

relationships.dataDescription: The selected workbook's path and the import options the user chose: target table, header row, and whether to replace existing rows.
relationships.purpose: Opens step 1 of Import a workbook. Nothing downstream runs until this arrives, and the options it carries decide how every later stage behaves.

relationships.dataDescription: The ordered stage plan: which sheets to open, in what order, and which may be skipped.
relationships.purpose: Fixes the read order before any I/O, so a failure in step 2 can name the stage it happened in rather than an arbitrary sheet.

relationships.dataDescription: A read request for the workbook at the selected path.
relationships.purpose: The only point at which the import touches the filesystem, so step 2 works from the file as it is on disk rather than anything cached.

relationships.dataDescription: The workbook's raw bytes, or a read error when the file is missing or locked.
relationships.purpose: Supplies the only content the import can be built from; a read error here ends the run before any sheet is parsed.

relationships.dataDescription: Decoded rows from one sheet, streamed in sheet order, each still holding raw cell text.
relationships.purpose: Streams rather than materialising the sheet, so step 2 can handle workbooks larger than memory.

relationships.dataDescription: One warning per unreadable cell, carrying its sheet, row, column, and the raw text that failed.
relationships.purpose: Reports bad cells as they are found instead of dropping them, so step 3 can tell the user which rows were skipped and why.

relationships.dataDescription: The parsed sheet: its header row and the rows produced by parsing, typed where parsing succeeded.
relationships.purpose: Hands parsing's output to mapping, where sheet rows become records for the target table. This begins Confirm the column mapping.

relationships.dataDescription: Each header name paired with the target columns it might map to.
relationships.purpose: Produces a ranked proposal rather than a guess, so step 1 of Confirm the column mapping shows the user something worth correcting.

relationships.dataDescription: One header name on its way to being lowercased, trimmed, and stripped of punctuation.
relationships.purpose: Keeps scoring stable across casing and spacing, so the same workbook exported twice proposes the same mapping.

relationships.dataDescription: The ranked mapping proposal: each header, its suggested target column, and a confidence score.
relationships.purpose: Shows the proposal before any data is coerced, which is what makes step 1 of Confirm the column mapping a review rather than a notification.

relationships.dataDescription: The mapping the user accepted, including any column they redirected or excluded.
relationships.purpose: Returns the decision from step 2 of Confirm the column mapping. It is the contract every later coercion follows.

relationships.dataDescription: Each cell's raw value together with the target column type the confirmed mapping assigns it.
relationships.purpose: Applies the confirmed mapping value by value, producing the typed rows recorded in step 3 of Confirm the column mapping.

relationships.dataDescription: A per-stage summary of the collected warnings: counts by severity and the first few examples of each.
relationships.purpose: Turns accumulated warnings into a run-level verdict, so step 3 reports one outcome instead of a stream of individual failures.

relationships.dataDescription: The run report: rows imported, rows skipped, and the stage that failed when one did.
relationships.purpose: Delivers the outcome of step 3. Until it arrives the panel still shows the import as running.

relationships.dataDescription: Writes the finished run into `result`, replacing whatever the previous import left there.
relationships.purpose: Retains the outcome past the run so step 3 can redisplay it without repeating the import.

relationships.dataDescription: Writes the decoded sheet into `buffer`, replacing the sheet decoded before it.
relationships.purpose: Holds one sheet at a time so re-reading a sheet during step 2 does not decode the workbook again.

relationships.dataDescription: Appends each row's warnings to `entries`, which accumulates across every sheet in the run.
relationships.purpose: Accumulates rather than replaces, so step 3 can judge the run as a whole instead of reporting only the last sheet.

relationships.dataDescription: Adds the sheet's mapped rows to `result`, alongside rows already recorded for earlier sheets.
relationships.purpose: Writes step 3 of Confirm the column mapping onto the shared run result, which is what the final report reads.
